name: Coca-Cola UNITED - Marietta Production Plant, GA

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (33.9357,-84.5037) landed in a residential apartment area ~5km SE. Correct site is 1091 Industrial Park Dr, Marietta GA 30062 (Coca-Cola UNITED Marietta Production page lists this address). Confirmed by Street View showing the Coca-Cola script logo and bottling silos on the building facade fronting Franklin Gateway/Industrial Park Dr.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding gate observed across the truck driveway off Industrial Park Dr. The truck yard is surrounded by chain-link perimeter fence but the driveway entrance from the public road is an open, uncontrolled curb cut. Flagged uncertain - a gate could exist out of Street View coverage but none seen across multiple headings.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth seen at the entrance. A small structure exists near the entrance area but appears to be part of the building cluster, not a checkpoint booth.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop-trailer yard along the north side of the building holds roughly 38 trailers in the imagery, in marked rows with directional arrows painted on the pavement.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 30 loading-dock doors along the north building face where trailers are backed in; counted from zoom-20 imagery, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately north of the property along the truck yard but no spur appears to enter the Coca-Cola property - the yard pavement abuts the rail right-of-way with a fence. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved yard between the open entrance and the dock doors provides ample queue/staging room inside the property.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal approach from the Industrial Park Dr entrance to the dock doors is deep, easily holding 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main production/warehouse building plus the office wing and a separate maintenance/shop structure in the truck yard.
